limitations: L4 denotes offline synthetic fixture acceptance only, never assay, physical or clinical validity.

Independent equal-volume partitions and accurate readout, volume, dilution and reaction-to-sample multipliers are unverified assumptions. Exact intervals exclude their uncertainty and post-selection effects.
NTC failures, saturation, inadequate partitions and missing counts preserve unavailable concentration. Zero positives have a positive exact upper bound and never establish absence.

Hashes cannot prove historical freeze timing or true source independence. Review always remains unavailable; computed agreement and review approval never support positive claims. One fixture cannot establish replication.

Conservative case-insensitive English whole-word/prefix families: caus*, mechanis*, therap*, clinic*, efficac*, effective*, treat*, cure*, prevent*, recommend*, prescri*, bind*, affinit*, inhibit*, activat*, regulat*, drive/drives/driv*, induc*. Also truth, physical validity, patient benefit, copy-number, gene dosage, disease* and sample suitability. The gate includes negations and is incomplete.
Read-only inputs are bounded to 64 MiB each, 256 MiB aggregate and 4000000 JSON values; hardlink aliases share initial reads and parsing.
